scenarios.name: create-and-read
scenarios.about: a minimal create answers 201 with defaults; get, list and the created event agree

scenarios.name: create-full-and-done
scenarios.about: every writable field on create; an offset due_at is stored as UTC; status done stamps completed_at

scenarios.name: create-validation
scenarios.about: unknown, empty, mistyped and system-owned fields are refused with validation_error and write nothing

error.message: Invalid input: expected string, received undefined
Too small: expected string to have >=1 characters

scenarios.name: completion
scenarios.about: completed_at follows status: open to done stamps, done to done keeps, done to open clears, no status leaves it

scenarios.name: patch-variants
scenarios.about: an empty patch checks existence and writes nothing; a same-value patch is a real update; null clears nullable fields

scenarios.name: references
scenarios.about: an assignee must be a principal of this vault; checked after existence, before any write; null is always fine

scenarios.name: delete
scenarios.about: delete is soft: the record leaves get, list and update; a second delete is not_found; the event carries the last record

scenarios.name: list-filters-and-pages
scenarios.about: filters are equality, pages are id-ordered with an opaque next_cursor, bad filters and limits are validation errors
